counting: production means non-test-named Rust LOC, including inline tests, comments and blanks; overlapping subtrees are not summed
rationale: Freeze reviewed baseline with at most 5% growth; preserve stricter existing limits; never rebase automatically in CI.
dns_audit_regression_rationale: 2026-10-17: account only for new DNS audit regression test lines; production limits unchanged.
dns_send_scheduling_rationale: 2026-10-17: account for owned DNS send operations and per-poll IO sharing in resident UDP, payload ownership transfer in transport, and controlled backpressure/external protocol regressions in dataplane; only measured overages are adjusted, without extra growth allowance.
dns_domain_routing_dispatch_rationale: 2026-10-18: account only for domain-routing expiry, FIFO admission, worker progress, cancellation and queued-commit regression tests; production limits unchanged, no extra growth allowance.
tcp_udp_lifecycle_regression_rationale: 2026-10-24: account only for measured overages from cancellation/publication, H2 incarnation, pool shutdown, UDP queued-batch accounting and independent TCP lifetime/FIFO-budget regressions. No extra growth allowance; existing production budgets stay unchanged except the resident UDP lifecycle/accounting implementation.
carrier_key_idle_ttl_rationale: 2026-10-26: account only for measured source growth from explicit carrier entry pins, bounded empty-key reclamation, shared weak H1 idle maintenance and their lifecycle/real-transport regression tests; no extra growth allowance.
